title: My red ball
author: African Storybook
content:
Ball.

My ball.

My red ball.

My big red ball.

I kick.

I kick my ball.

I kick my red ball.

I kick my red ball hard!

Where?

Where is my ball?

Where is my ball now?

Where is my red ball
now?

It is up.

It is high up.

It is high up in the sky.

It is high up in the sky.
It is over the moon.
It is gone!
